name: PlanarNeRF
definition: An online learning model for 3D planar detection and global tracking that combines plane segmentation rendering, an efficient plane fitting module, and a global memory bank. It learns from monocular RGB and depth sequences.
summary: PlanarNeRF is an online learning framework that detects dense 3D planar primitives from monocular sequences by combining plane segmentation rendering with a global memory bank for consistent plane tracking.
